record_type_quote: Our goal in these two experiments was to replicate research on metamotivational beliefs about the usefulness of getting in a promotion focus or prevention focus for eager tasks and vigilant tasks (Nguyen et al., 2021).

targets.authors: Nguyen, T., Togawa, T., Scholer, A. A., Miele, D. B., & Fujita, K.
targets.title: A cross-cultural investigation of metamotivational beliefs about regulatory focus task-motivation fit
targets.evidence_quote: This research replicated two studies on metamotivational beliefs about the usefulness of promotion and prevention focus for various tasks. Specifically, we replicated the American-independent conditions of Nguyen et al.’s (2021) Experiments 2 and 3 and compared them with results that the original authors provided to us. Our findings showed the same patterns of effects as in the original experiments, and the effect sizes were similarly large.
